headline: Iran restores damaged South Pars gas pipelines to production adding 20 million cubic metres daily
label: NEWS
caption:
Iran brings repaired gas pipelines back to life to boost winter energy supply ⚡

Iran has repaired three gas pipelines damaged in the early weeks of the US Israeli war, returning them to production at the South Pars gas field according to the country's state run Mehr news agency.

The agency reported that lines 1 and 4 of the fourth refinery and line 3 of the sixth refinery are back in operation, adding 20 million cubic metres of gas a day to Iran's gas output capacity.

President Masoud Pezeshkian announced the development, saying getting through the winter without cutting off electricity and fuel requires public support and infrastructure improvement.

War damage to Iran energy infrastructure has compounded energy shortages, leading authorities to announce two hour electricity cuts in parts of the country as winter draws close.
